tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide and document background; cards that sit on the warm canvas. Default ground for all text tokens.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Warm off-white page background for websites and landing pages. Documents and slides stay on surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Warm grey panels, cards and bands sitting on surface or canvas; alternate table rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: code blocks, input fills, the cover-page client box.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table borders and dividers. Decorative only; never the only thing marking a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, footers and metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Deep brand ground: dark title slides, footer bands, the cover block. Pair with on-navy text.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and the reversed logo on a navy fill.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Incaendo Blue (#145AA8, measured from the logo). Supporting colour only (under 5%): focus ring, info messages, chart series 3. As text, on surface, canvas, surface-raised or blue-soft.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind blue text: info callouts and info badges only.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blue fill.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Action orange: primary buttons and the main call to action. White label in light theme (4.84:1), navy label in dark theme. Never use the logo orange for buttons.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of action fills.

tokens.name: action-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed (active) state of action fills. White label 7.78:1 in light theme.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, the mobile menu and image lightboxes.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (the series that matters most).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. 3.15:1 on white, so label the series directly.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 and 'other'. Five series at most; prefer bars.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Logo orange (#EE5D10, measured from the logo). Accents only: section bars, the i-dot, the + on stats, large display text 24px+. 3.4:1 on white, so never for body text or with a white label; use orange-text or action.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Readable orange for text: eyebrows, links, highlighted words in headlines, icons. On surface, canvas, surface-raised or orange-soft.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Brand tint: icon circles, highlighted cards, callouts, table header rows, brand badges. Pair with orange-text or ink.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text on an orange fill. Navy, not white: white on brand orange is only 3.4:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, approved, on track. Always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: At risk, pending, needs attention. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocked, failed, overdue. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Stays blue so it stands out from orange buttons. At least 5.5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of orange-text, so links follow the readable brand orange in every theme.

styles.name: web-display
styles.sample: We build your software, so you can focus on your business
styles.usage: Website and landing page hero headline, one per page. 36px/44px on phones.

styles.name: web-h1
styles.sample: Everything you need to build and run a digital product
styles.usage: Inner page titles on the web. 32px/40px on phones.

styles.name: web-h2
styles.sample: Working together, openly, from day one

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Software that cares for your users
styles.usage: Cover titles and title slides. One per page.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Phase 1: Research and AI agent development

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above a title, uppercase, in orange-text.

styles.name: web-lead
styles.sample: From the first sketch to long after launch, our close-knit team designs, builds and looks after your product.
styles.usage: Hero and section lead paragraphs on the web. 18px/28px on phones.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We build digital platforms for startups, SMEs and enterprises.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: This proposal sets out our understanding of your requirement and how we will deliver it.
styles.usage: Default text for pages and documents (11pt in Word or Google Docs).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy and table headers.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Includes infrastructure charges in all phases.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footers, figure captions, legal lines; ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Endpoints, commands and code in technical proposals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related lines; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections; slide margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins on covers and title slides; section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of website sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero padding and the largest section breaks on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, table corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards. The default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, slide content boxes, the proposal cover box.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and tags only.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised cards on a surface or the warm canvas. Prefer surface-raised over shadow where possible.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Floating elements: dropdowns, sticky header once scrolled, hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Modals and the open mobile menu only.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: large phones. Below this, one column and full-width buttons.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: tablets. Two-column grids start here.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: laptops. Full navigation replaces the mobile menu; three-column grids.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: desktops. Four-column grids and the widest hero layouts.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Maximum width for reading text: articles, section intros, forms.

tokens.name: container-content
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content on websites and landing pages.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Grid gutter and page side padding from bp-md up.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Grid gutter and page side padding on phones.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable, including padding around text links.
